topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: Opening framing introducing the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of microbial and damage sensing via PAMPs and DAMPs
topics.groupedBecause: They establish the foundational principles by which the innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury using molecular patterns while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and intracellular signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the genetics, subcellular localization, and downstream activation cascades of pattern recognition receptor families and inflammasome complexes.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how tissue sentinel cells initiate inflammatory cascades, direct leukocyte trafficking and lymphatic drainage, and can precipitate septic shock when overactivated.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the mechanisms that resolve inflammation and promote tissue repair, as well as the causes and outcomes of chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: Closing framing concluding the lecture and announcing the upcoming topic.
